name: Word Search in Grid
description: Finds if a word exists in a 2D character grid by exploring adjacent cells (up/down/left/right) using DFS with backtracking.
aim: Search the grid by DFS from each cell matching the first character, extending to neighbors for subsequent characters.
howItWorks: For each grid cell matching word[0]: start DFS
DFS: check if current cell matches word[index]
Recursively check all 4 neighbors for word[index+1]
Return true if full word found

time.worstCase: Large grid with many partial matches

alternatives: Trie-based search for multiple words simultaneously (Aho-Corasick)

inputHint: Grid rows separated by "/", then a comma and the word to find.
